_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (read 2026-11-05): Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced PER REQUEST by prompt length; a request's prompt length counts all input tokens including cache reads and cache writes. USD per 1,000,000 tokens. cache_write is the 5-minute write price.
_argentic_step_source: Argentic charges $1 per 1,000 agent steps after a plan's included steps; a step is one model reply the engine journaled (site lib/plans.ts WAKE_USD, hosted AUTUMN_WAKE_USD). It is billed by Argentic on top of the model spend, which is on the customer's own key. The monthly plan fee is not counted.
